The '''Civilized sector''' was one of the two sectors of [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]]. Its inhabitants were called the [[Civilized]], the wealthier people of New Apsolon. The Civilized sector also contained the government buildings.

==History==
For many years the inhabitants of the Civilized sector ruled over the [[New Apsolon/Legends|planet]]. They used their secret police, the [[Absolutes]], to keep the inhabitants of the [[Worker sector]] under control. In [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]] the [[Workers]] rebelled against the Civilized government. The Workers managed to win and a democratic government was installed. An [[energy wall]] dividing the two sectors was taken down. Many people in the Civilized sector still supported the Absolutists and the old government. When Qui-Gon visited the city in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]] he thought that the poorer Worker sector was in stark contrast to the Civilized sector.
